name: Unstub Borrow Checker — Move Analysis, Two-Phase Borrows, Projection Conflicts
scope_summary: Remove all stubs in glyim-borrowck related to move analysis (count_fields, Index projections), two-phase borrow cross-block tracking, and mixed projection conflict detection. Replace with fully functional, production-ready implementations.

stub_targets.replacement_scope: Replace substs.len() with AdtDef query: ctx.adt_def(*adt_id).and_then(|adt| adt.variants.first().map(|v| v.fields.len() as u32))
When Index projection is encountered, return current_idx immediately (root move path). Arrays/slices are moved wholesale.
Replace with forward dataflow analysis: worklist of successor blocks, scan for dest_local reads, track visited (block, stmt_idx) points in per_block BitSet
Replace conservative conflict with: (Field, Index) | (Index, Field) => return false (disjoint physical regions)

tests.name: count_fields_uses_adt_def_not_substs
tests.description: count_fields returns the actual field count from AdtDef, not the generic substitution length
tests.input_code: struct Point<i32> { x: i32, y: i32 } // 1 type param, 2 fields

tests.name: index_projection_returns_root_move_path
tests.description: Moving arr[i] marks the whole array as moved, so accessing arr[j] later is an error
tests.input_code: let arr = [String::new(), String::new()]; let s = arr[0]; let t = arr[1]; // ERROR
tests.expected: Use-after-move error on arr[1] because root path is in moved set
edge_cases: copy types in array don't move

tests.name: two_phase_cross_block_reservation_survives
tests.description: Two-phase borrow created in BB0, shared borrow in BB1, activation in BB2 — no error because reservation survives across blocks
tests.input_mir: BB0: _2 = &mut _1 (two-phase); goto BB1 | BB1: _3 = &shared _1; _4 = copy _3; goto BB2 | BB2: _5 = copy _2; return
tests.expected: No borrow conflict error — shared borrow during reservation is allowed
edge_cases: reservation killed by block that reads dest_local

tests.name: mixed_field_index_projections_disjoint
tests.description: arr[0].field and arr.field[0] (if well-typed) are disjoint — no conflict
edge_cases: same projection kind at same depth still conflicts

tests.name: move_then_use_array_element_error
tests.description: Moving one array element then using the whole array triggers use-of-moved-value
tests.input_code: let arr = [s1, s2]; let x = arr[0]; let y = arr; // ERROR: arr partially moved
tests.expected: Error: use of partially moved value
edge_cases: copy element types don't trigger move

mocking: Use MockBorrowckCtx from glyim-test. For MIR construction, use MirBodyBuilder pattern from existing tests. No external solver needed.
conflict_note: No conflicts. Owns glyim-borrowck exclusively. No other stream touches this crate.

name: Unstub LLVM Backend — ABI Layout, Lowering, Drop Glue, Debug Info, Passes
scope_summary: Remove all stubs in glyim-codegen-llvm related to ABI enum layout (niche, multi-variant), MIR lowering (fat string pointers, enum tags, slice projections, direct calls, byval args, pointer casts, drop glue with real sizes, StorageLive/Dead), LLVM pass pipeline mapping, and debug info (declare_local). Provide fully functional implementations.

stub_targets.replacement_scope: Fetch AdtDef. If 1 variant: layout fields sequentially, VariantsShape::Single. If multiple: compute each variant layout, find max size/align, determine tag size, construct VariantsShape::Multiple with TagEncoding::Direct or Niche.
Construct fat pointer struct {i8*, i64}: create global string, build_insert_value at index 0 (ptr) and index 1 (len). Return struct value.
Call global.set_initializer(&val) before loading. Generate val from the constant kind.
GEP to start index, load data pointer, construct {ptr, i64} fat pointer struct via build_alloca + build_store, return pointer to temp.
Fetch layout via FullLayoutComputer. If VariantsShape::Multiple, extract tag_field and tag_size. Store variant_idx at tag_field offset using build_gep + build_store.
Implement: if tag == niche_start { return untagged_variant } else { return tag - niche_start + niche_variants.start() }. Use build_select for conditional.
Check if func is Operand::Constant(MirConstKind::Fn). If so, resolve to FunctionValue and use build_call. For indirect args (PassMode::Indirect), add byval attribute via create_type_attribute.
Emit builder.build_bit_cast(val, target_llvm_ty, "ptrcast"). Same for FnPtrToPtr.
Compute real layout: let layout = FullLayoutComputer::new(self.ty_ctx, self.target_info.clone()).layout_of(place_ty).unwrap(); Use layout.size.0 and layout.align.0 as u64.
Generate per-type drop glue function glyim_drop_in_place_<ty_hash> in lower_body. In StorageDead, call drop glue if type_needs_drop. In StorageLive, emit llvm.lifetime.start.
Remove eprintln. Ensure (2, true) maps to default<Os>. All tuples map correctly.

stub_targets.line_pattern: // Placeholder - not used in this stream's tests
stub_targets.replacement_scope: Emit llvm.dbg.declare: create DI type, create parameter variable, build debug location, call self.builder.insert_declare_at_end(alloca, local_var, None, location, block).

tests.description: MirConstKind::String produces {i8*, i64} struct, not bare i8*
tests.expected_ir: IR contains insertvalue with i64 length 5 at index 1

tests.name: enum_aggregate_writes_discriminant_tag
tests.description: AggregateKind::Adt stores variant index at tag offset
tests.expected_ir: IR contains store of variant index at tag_field offset

tests.name: direct_call_uses_build_call_not_indirect
edge_cases: function pointer calls still use indirect

tests.name: indirect_arg_has_byval_attribute
tests.description: Large struct argument passed indirectly has byval LLVM attribute
tests.expected_ir: IR contains 'byval' attribute on call parameter
edge_cases: small args pass direct without byval

tests.name: pointer_cast_emits_bitcast
tests.input_mir: local_1 = Cast(PtrToPtr, src_ptr, dest_ty); return local_1
tests.expected_ir: IR contains 'bitcast' instruction, not bare value passthrough
edge_cases: same-type cast is identity (no bitcast needed)

tests.name: dealloc_passes_real_size_and_align
tests.description: glyim_dealloc call passes actual layout size/align, not 0
tests.expected_ir: IR contains call to glyim_dealloc with non-zero size and align arguments
edge_cases: Copy types skip drop but may still dealloc

tests.name: storage_dead_calls_drop_glue
tests.description: StorageDead for a type needing drop calls the generated drop glue function
tests.expected_ir: IR contains call to glyim_drop_in_place_<hash> before dealloc
edge_cases: Copy types do not call drop glue
partial moves skip drop on moved fields

tests.name: multi_variant_enum_layout_has_tag
tests.description: Layout for enum with >1 variant has VariantsShape::Multiple with tag
tests.expected_layout: layout.variants is Multiple { tag_size > 0, tag_encoding: Direct or Niche }
edge_cases: enum with >256 variants needs larger tag

tests.name: slice_projection_returns_fat_pointer_not_null
tests.description: ProjectionElem::Slice returns {ptr, len} struct, not null pointer
tests.expected_ir: IR does NOT contain 'inttoptr (i64 0'. Contains GEP to slice start and struct construction.
edge_cases: full slice [..] copies original fat pointer

tests.description: declare_local emits llvm.dbg.declare intrinsic for local variables
tests.input_mir: Body with var_debug_info containing one local

name: Unstub CLI — Emit Modes (mir, llvm-ir), Linker Invocation, Attribute Fix
scope_summary: Remove all stubs in glyim-cli related to emit modes and linker invocation. Fix duplicate clap attribute bug. Implement --emit mir, --emit llvm-ir, --emit exec. Create linker.rs that shells out to cc to link .o against libc.

stub_targets.replacement_scope: Remove the duplicate #[arg] line. Only keep #[arg(short = 'O', long = "opt-level", default_value = "0")] on opt_level field.
Before compile_file, match on args.emit: 'mir' => Pipeline::emit_mir, 'llvm-ir' => Pipeline::emit_llvm_ir. After compile_file, if emit == 'exec', call linker::invoke_linker.

tests.name: emit_mir_flag_produces_mir_text
tests.description: --emit mir outputs MIR text and exits before codegen
tests.expected: Pipeline::emit_mir is called, no .o file created

tests.name: emit_llvm_ir_flag_produces_llvm_text
tests.description: --emit llvm-ir outputs LLVM IR text and exits before object write
tests.expected: Pipeline::emit_llvm_ir is called, no .o file created
edge_cases: --emit llvm-ir with invalid source still type-checks

tests.name: emit_exec_invokes_linker
tests.description: --emit exec (or default) compiles .o then invokes cc linker to produce executable
tests.expected: After .o generation, linker::invoke_linker is called with cc
edge_cases: linker fails with non-zero exit code

tests.name: no_duplicate_arg_attribute
tests.description: clap parsing doesn't panic from duplicate #[arg] attributes
tests.expected: opt_level parsed as 2, emit defaults to 'obj'

mocking: No mocking needed. Use tempfile::NamedTempFile for input files. For linker tests, mock std::process::Command or just verify the function signature compiles. Do NOT actually invoke cc in unit tests.
conflict_note: No conflicts. Owns glyim-cli exclusively. No other stream touches this crate.
